THEMIS · attribution reliability register · Bitcoin

Where did this label actually come from?

A blockchain records transfers, not identities. Everything an investigator says about who controlled an address is a claim layered on top, drawn from a short list of public corpora. This register audits those corpora: what corroborates what, which agreement is inherited rather than independent, and what it does to a forensic figure.
